verdict.rationale: Docs confirm real-time transcription via the unified WebSocket API, selectable LLM providers (docs-9), and multilingual STT/TTS model choices (docs-10), giving developers meaningful control over STT and LLM models. However, there is no evidence of 'key terms' or keyword-boosting controls specific to the Voice Agent's transcription pipeline. Missing for 10: explicit key-term/keyword-boost configuration support, independent benchmarking of transcription accuracy.
